name: Summer Teen Internship Program
what_you_do: Work as a Visitor Services Assistant or an Aquarium Guide, greeting visitors and explaining exhibits and ocean conservation, with training in marine science, climate science and public speaking.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 and older. The majority of internships are open to residents of Boston and Cambridge.
pay_detail: All teen internships are paid positions (rate not stated)
duration: One week of training and six weeks of work
deadline_text: The summer 2026 application is closed. The page says to check back next March for the summer 2027 application.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the application opens (expected next March). Interns also attend a weekly professional development course and an ocean advocacy course. Questions: teens@neaq.org.
notes: Paid job, so teens under 18 need a Massachusetts work permit (the aquarium page does not mention it; M.G.L. c.149 s.86 and the Boston youth worker rights page, written with the state Attorney General's Office, cover the permit rule). The aquarium also runs ClimaTeens (ages 13 and up, 2026-27 applications due October 18, 2026).
